verdict.rationale: Connecting a domain to a host is a fair question for a registrar, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows general DNS management through the API, MCP review of nameservers and DNS records, and WHMCS reseller integration. None of it documents DNS templates or one-click connect flows for major hosts or platforms, and API-based DNS editing is only a developer building block.

support.subject: As a founder, connecting the domain to where my site lives is one guided step — templates or one-click connect for the major hosts and platforms
